name: 新西兰绿色清单工作转居留签证
nameEn: New Zealand Work to Residence Visa
summary: 面向已在新西兰绿色清单 Tier 2 职位完成规定工作时间，并有认可雇主相应工作或邀请的人士。
summaryEn: For people who completed the required New Zealand work in a Green List Tier 2 role and hold qualifying employment or an offer with an accredited employer.

age.summary: 申请时须年满 55 岁或以下。
age.summaryEn: You must be aged 55 or younger when applying.

currentJob.summary: 当前须在绿色清单 Tier 2 全职职位工作或有相应邀请，雇主须获认可，工作通常须为永久或至少 12 个月固定期限。
currentJob.summaryEn: You must currently work in or hold an offer for a full-time Green List Tier 2 role with an accredited employer, generally permanent or fixed-term for at least 12 months.

workExperience.summary: 申请前最近 30 个月内，须在新西兰符合条件的绿色清单 Tier 2 职位工作满 24 个月。
workExperience.summaryEn: At least 24 months of qualifying New Zealand work in a Green List Tier 2 role within the 30 months before applying is required.

roleRequirements.summary: 须满足该职位适用的工资、资格、注册及其他绿色清单条件。
roleRequirements.summaryEn: The applicable pay, qualification, registration and other Green List conditions for the role must be met.

english.summaryEn: You must meet the English requirement.

disclaimer: 本资料仅供一般教育用途，不构成个性化移民或法律建议。
